title: TotemTracker
body:
# TotemTracker

Tracks totem usage per player.

## Features
- Counts totems used via EntityResurrect.
- Stores data in data.yml.
- Command to view counts.
- Lightweight tracking.

## Command
- `/totemtrack [player]`

## Permissions
- `totemtracker.use`
- `totemtracker.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
message: '&eTotems used: &f{count}'
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
